title: AAPS freezes if BT communication with Medtrum is disrupted
symptom: AAPS freezes when BT communication with Medtrum is disrupted, leaving the app interface blank or unusable, and Android reports that AAPS is not responding. Restarting the app fixes the problem. Freezes also occurred after syncing with Nightscout without Medtrum involvement.
evidence_quote: Since I haven't observed any more freezes with the new dev versions, I'm closing the issue.
